name: Thukra Ke Mera Pyaar
description: Two families clash over societal and caste differences spurring a saga of revenge. All this happens when a love story goes wrong.

videos.title: Chauhano Ki Shaan
videos.overview: Shanvika, the arrogant daughter of the elite Chauhan family. Kuldeep, a poor but brilliant young man. A broken bicycle leads to a meaningful exchange between the two.

videos.title: Humse Dosti Karoge?
videos.overview: Nakul and his cronies try to snatch Kuldeep's new bicycle from him, leading to a fight. Shanvika interferes, and she poses a question to Kuldeep.

videos.title: Aapki Pehchan Hai Kya?
videos.overview: Kuldeep's disinterest in her proposal makes Shanvika angry. She vows to outscore him academically, setting the stage for competition.

videos.title: Namak Harami Mat Karna
videos.overview:
Shanvika misbehaves with Inspector Dushyant Singh when she declares

she'll rank first in her class. Her "hard work" bears fruit, and Kuldeep goes missing. Where did he go?

videos.title: Ishq Hua Hai!
videos.overview: Shanvika and Kuldeep's romance blossoms. However, one day, Pushkar and his men bust their blissful moment, leading to tension between the families.

videos.title: Galti Hamari Nahi Thi
videos.overview: Shanvika's declaration leads to Kuldeep's family being humiliated in public. They flee for life after Pushkar sets fire to their house, but Simmi's tragic step shatters them.

videos.title: Saaye Mai Dhoop
videos.overview: Kuldeep starts driving a rickshaw for a living. Prerna, a passenger preparing for the UPSC exams, inspires him to reflect on his dreams and look forward to a bright future.

videos.title: Namak Haram
videos.overview: Family pressures Shanvika into marrying Dushyant reluctantly. Kuldeep focuses on studies but faces devastation after a fateful call.

videos.title: Tu Hoga Kamyaab
videos.overview: Shanvika's rejection of Dushyant on their wedding night sparks turmoil. Kuldeep grapples with inner conflicts as Prerna guides him to harness his anger constructively.

videos.title: Chaman Mein Deedawar
videos.overview: Kuldeep's life hangs in the balance as he faces his UPSC final interview and his mother's coma. The UPSC results bring a shocking revelation, especially those in Sitaarpur.

videos.title: Mera Lakshya Kuch Aur Hai
videos.overview: Kuldeep's political return sparks chaos when he proposes building a bridge in a Chauhan area. Daddu proposes an easy way for him to do it.

videos.title: Astitwa ki Ladai
videos.overview: Under Kuldeep's orders, all boating operations are sealed, paving the way for the bridge project. During his and Mala's wedding, tensions escalate with the arrival of the Chauhans.

videos.title: Bhoot, Bhavishya, Vartaman
videos.overview: The Chauhans are infuriated seeing Dushyant guarding Kuldeep. Mala speaks to her new husband about their future. The Chauhan's face losses when their businesses are raided.

videos.title: Woh Badla Lene Hi Aaya Hai
videos.overview: Dushyant warns Shanvika of Kuldeep's desire for revenge but she refuses to engage. Fed up with Kuldeep's high handed behaviour, the Chauhans hire Gauri to kill him.

videos.title: Kuch Bachna Nahi Chahiye
videos.overview: Gauri, on the run from the police, is abducted by unknown men. He urgently contacts Angad to meet the Chauhans at their hideout. Meanwhile, Kuldeep raids the Chauhan's house

videos.title: Ghar Ka Malik Bhag Chala
videos.overview: The Chauhan brothers surrender, which creates a sensation. In prison, Manohar wonders about his past actions. Meanwhile, Kuldeep throws a party and invites Dushyant and Shanvika

videos.title: Ab Apna Rasta Badal Lo
videos.overview: Dushyant decides to resign, but Kuldeep refuses and makes an offer. Gendalal warns Kuldeep about Daddu, who has a different plan for Chauhan's son in law.

videos.title: Sab Kuch Khatam Ho Gaya
videos.overview: Daddu instructs SP Mishra to apprehend Pushkar, but he flees. Shanvika consoles a troubled Dushyant. Kuldeep meets his childhood friend Pintu, who advises him.

videos.title: Ab Humari Baari
videos.overview: Kuldeep finally learns why Shanvika lied about their relationship. Tragedy strikes yet again, and Shanvika has no choice but to pick up the pieces of her shattered life.

videos.title: Naye Dushman ya Naye Dost?
videos.overview: Shanvika performs her husband Dushyant's last rites as Sitaarpur watches. On her journey home, she is ambushed, forcing her into a gun fight. Who is her new enemy?

videos.title: Kunwar ki Ummid, Shanvika ki Chaal
videos.overview: Kuldeep spirals into guilt over Shanvika despite Mala and Daddu's efforts to help him. Tensions rise as a looming threat pushes Shanvika to make a strategic move.

videos.title: Bas Ek Mulakaat
videos.overview: Multiple attacks on Shanvika heighten tensions across Sitaarpur. As she prepares herself for the battles ahead, a shocking revelation shakes her trust.

videos.title: Kuldeep ka Prayashchit
videos.overview: Angad finds himself trapped in Shanvika's scheme, while Kuldeep's guilt drives him toward a risky move. As political conspiracies deepen, Shanvika finally agrees to meet Kuldeep.

videos.title: Pyaar ka Nostalgia
videos.overview: Shanvika confronts Kuldeep, gun in hand, yet her pain overpowers her anger. They exchange their losses, leading Kuldeep to agree to join her dangerous quest for justice.

videos.title: Pushkar ki Jaan ko Khatra hai
videos.overview: Chaos erupts as Pushkar faces danger in the hospital, but Shanvika intervenes to rescue him. Angad shoots a corrupt doctor unaware that he is under surveillance.

videos.title: Raajneeti par Pyaar Bhaari
videos.overview: Kunwar assures Shanvika of his support but grows furious over Pushkar's disappearance, suspecting Daddu. Shanvika and Kuldeep clash when she admits ordering Dr Vinay's murder.

videos.title: Shanvika ka Naya Rakshak
videos.overview: Shanvika is ambushed but saved by a masked shooter, leaving Daddu shaken. Suspicious, Daddu asks Singh to bring Mala home and keep a close watch on Kuldeep.

videos.title: Transfer yaa Saazish?
videos.overview: Obsessed with Kuldeep, Mala opposes Daddu's plan to kill him and pledges to ruin Shanvika. Subsequently, Daddu discloses Kuldeep's unexpected transfer order, shocking Kuldeep.

videos.title: Nani ki Seekh, Pyaar ki Jeet
videos.overview: Daddu celebrates his political move and plots Shanvika's death after Kuldeep's transfer. A powerful flashback inspires Kuldeep to move in a way that leaves Daddu stunned.

videos.title: Imaandari ka Sabut
videos.overview: Saadhu and Kundan commit a crime, triggering a chain reaction that shakes Sitaarpur. Shanvika quietly turns the fallout to her advantage by letting Kunwar take the credit.

videos.title: Varchasva ki Ladai!
videos.overview: Poornima's death sparks an all-out war as Daddu Prasad commands the annihilation of Kunwar's family. Amid the turmoil, Shanvika and Pushkar secretly scheme for their rise.

videos.title: Deewaron Ke Bhi Aakhein Hoti Hain
videos.overview: Prerna and Pushkar grow closer, unaware of the danger ahead. As panic spreads over the police murders, Daddu uses Angad to trap Shanvika, but Kuldeep foils the plan.

videos.title: Kaptaan Mara Gaya!
videos.overview: As Angad is hidden away for safety, Kuldeep manipulates Daddu's suspicions. Daddu then orders Saadhu and Kundan to kill Shanvika or pay with their lives.

videos.title: 2 Prime Suspects!
videos.overview: Public outrage over SP Mishra's murder prompts the Chief Minister to transfer the case to the Intelligence Agency. Shockingly, Shanvika and Kuldeep emerge as key suspects.

videos.title: Gheera!
videos.overview: Constable Divya's interrogation exposes SP Mishra's corruption. Suspicion grows around Kuldeep as Pradeep disappears, only to resurface under arrest for his covert role.

videos.title: Baazi Palat Gayi!
videos.overview: During Intelligence Agency’s probing, Angad reveals how Daddu Prasad planned murders to protect his power. Shanvika emerges as a formidable force in Sitaarpur’s political field.

videos.title: Alert!
videos.overview: The Intelligence Agency exposes Daddu Prasad’s political scheme and arrests him amid public outrage. While love and victory bring Kuldeep and Shanvika closer, Pintu is abducted.

videos.title: Uttaradhikari Mil Gaya!
videos.overview: As Pintu’s kidnapping haunts Kuldeep, Sitaarpur is sealed, criminals rounded up, and pressure mounts. While Daddu plots his comeback, Mala’s vengeance is finally exposed.

videos.title: Satta Ka Safar!
videos.overview: Kuldeep learns Pintu’s murder was meant to break him. He urges Shanvika to get into politics. She asserts control by striking a business deal. Kunwar assures her a minister’s post.

videos.title: Siyasi Zameen
videos.overview: Kunwar proposes Shanvika's candidature to the Chief Minister, shifting political equations. Meanwhile, Kuldeep mentors Shanvika, stirring old feelings and Mala's insecurity.

videos.title: Ticket Mil Gaya
videos.overview: Shanvika's political rise rattles Daddu and Kunwar. Celebrations begin at the Chauhan Mansion as Shanvika's ticket is announced, while masked men abduct Kuldeep's family.

videos.title: Maut ka Badla Maut!
videos.overview: Ranjan's death drives Chatki to seek revenge against Kunwar. Meanwhile, Daddu Prasad returns to politics after securing bail, raising the stakes for all.

videos.title: Shaam 5:00 Baje
videos.overview: A coded call helps Kuldeep escape captivity, exposing a conspiracy linked to Ramlal's camp. Shanvika's campaign sweeps the polls, defeating Daddu by a huge margin.
